findings.finding: A $50.0m at-the-market program with TD Cowen (amended sales agreement of 2026-08-13, shelf effective 2026-08-19) is open: the follow-on's 60-day company lock-up carves the ATM out once the underwriters' option is fully exercised, and it was, so the company can sell stock into tonight's or tomorrow's tape.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Not a dated event: an open, effective ATM can be drawn on 2026-10-07 without any further filing, which is why the brief counts it as in-window supply. Use is unlikely so soon after a $161.8m raise at $26, which is why it is sized small.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No ATM usage under this program has been disclosed; the stock's post-offering drift from $26 to $18.95 has come on falling volume (today 0.5x), which is consistent with either thin demand or unreported drip selling, and no filing establishes which.
findings.why_not_priced: The tape trades a thin $1m-a-day name with no visible seller; any ATM supply into a bounce caps the bounce that under-2x-volume falls usually get (+1.46% base rate). If it were priced, a low-volume fall would not be expected to rebound at all.
